now.empty: Nothing here. Dump what is in your head and Nowbi picks one thing.

settings.title: Settings
settings.languageHint: Arabic flips the whole layout right-to-left. The app restarts once to apply it.
settings.noShame: No-shame mode: always on. No red, no overdue, nothing dies.

plan.title: Today
plan.noShame: Nothing here is late. Later is just later.

dump.title: Brain dump
dump.prompt: Say everything. Nowbi picks the one thing.
dump.placeholder: Type it messy: "finish the report, call the dentist, Sara is waiting for the invoice answer, also buy milk"
dump.privacy: Stays on this phone. Nothing is sent anywhere.
dump.nothingFound: Nothing I could turn into a task. Try one thing per line.
dump.proposalHint: Anything over 25 min got steps. Reorder with the arrows; nothing is saved until you confirm.

welcome.pitch: Dump your brain. See one thing. Do it with company.
welcome.sub: A calm daily companion for ADHD adults. Never red, never overdue, nothing dies.
welcome.notConfigured: Accounts are not set up on this build yet (see SETUP-AUTH.md).
welcome.legal: By continuing you accept that your data stays on this phone unless you turn sync on.

auth.signupSub: One email to confirm, then you never see this screen again.

verify.title: We sent you a link
verify.sub: Tap Confirm in the email. This screen opens the app by itself as soon as you do.
verify.resent: Sent again. Give it a minute.
verify.notYet: Not confirmed yet. Tap the link in the email, then come back.
verify.spam: Not there? Look in spam, or resend.

errors.notConfigured: Accounts are not set up on this build.
errors.emailTaken: This email already has an account. Log in instead.
errors.badEmail: That email does not look right.
errors.rateLimit: Too many tries. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.googleOff: Google sign-in is not enabled yet.
errors.googleDev: Google sign-in is misconfigured (SHA-1 or client ID). See SETUP-AUTH.md.
